_meta.session: Session 94 — Qwen 3.6 + Gemma 4 per-quant benchmark deep dive
sources: Qwen 3.6 27B + 35B-A3B model cards + FP8 + GGUF discussions (HF)
Gemma 4 Google official QAT cards (E2B/E4B/12B/26B-A4B/31B) + RedHatAI FP8/NVFP4 + Unsloth GGUF
_meta.notes: Per-quant benchmark deep dive. Gemma 4 31B QAT Q4_0 17.7GB MMLU-Pro 85.2/AIME-26 89.2/CF ELO 2150. Gemma 4 26B-A4B Q4_0 14.4GB MoE. RedHatAI NVFP4 31B 99.5% BF16 recovery. Unsloth Dynamic E2B KLD 0.00173 vs naive 0.05109 (29x reduction). Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B-FP8 1397 QwenWebBench ELO. UD-Q6_K_XL HumanEval+ 90.24.
